title: Celtics' NBA Champion Sends Strong Message To Lizzo
htmlContent:
Glen "Big Baby" Davis' hoop days may have ended, but he still shoot his shot at Lizzo.

It all happened on the podcast 'ALL THE SMOKE,' when the former NBA star, who showed the mad love of the female rapper on her IG page, was asked if Lizzo was his celebrity crush.

"Yeah, I wanna do something with her," Davis shared with hosts Stephen Jackson and Matt Barnes.

"Yeah, I wanna do something with Lizzo. I ain't even gon' lie. I just like her personality."

But Jackson and Barnes let Davis grab the camera and send a message to the "About Damn Time" artist.

"Lizzo, I'm talking to you. I'm reaching out. I done see you a couple of times, I ain't really say nothing, but...I need you."

"I need you! Your energy, I feel like you and me together is a hell of a combination, and we represent for the big people."

Davis added, "I think you're awesome, you beautiful and you know...I like that!"

Unfortunately for Davis, Lizzo recently went public with her new boyfriend, actor Myke Wright. The couple appeared together at a red carpet event for her Amazon series "Beware of the Big Grrrls."
